verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਲਖ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: chauraaseeh lakh jon vich utam janamu su maanas dhehee|

en.bdb: Of the eighty four lacs life classes, birth as a human is the best.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਭਿ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਨੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: akhee vekhan karan sun mukh subh bolan bachan sanehee|

en.bdb: Eyes behold, ears listen to and the mouth speaks sweet words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲਿ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: hathee kaar kamaavanee pairee chal satisa(n)g milehee|

en.bdb: Hands earn livelihood and feet take towards the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਦੀ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਲਣੁ ਕਾਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kirat virat kar dharam dhee khaT khavaalan kaar karehee|

en.bdb: In human life alone by the rightful earning, out of one's savings, other needy ones are fed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa gurbaanee paReh samajh sunehee|

en.bdb: Man by becoming gurmukh- Guru oriented, makes his life meaningful; he reads Gurbani and makes others understand (the importance of) bani.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਸੰਤੁਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣਾਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਵੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurbhaiee sa(n)tusaT kar charanaamrit lai mukh pivehee|

en.bdb: He satisfies his companions and takes the holy water touched by their feet i.e. he inculcates complete humility.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pavan na chhoddeeaai kalee kaal raharaas karehee|

en.bdb: Humblytouching of the feet should not be repudiated because in the dark age, this quality is the only asset (of the human personality).
People of such a conduct will swim the world-ocean and also get along other disciples of the Guru.
